title: Prime Minister meets Sri Sri Vishwaprasanna Tirtha Swamiji of Sri Pejavara Adhokshaja Matha, Udupi, Karnataka
subtitle: PM unveils logo of birth centenary celebrations of Padma Vibhushan Yatikula Chakravarti Sri Vishwesha Tirtha Swamiji
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today met Sri Sri Vishwaprasanna Tirtha Swamiji of Sri Pejavara Adhokshaja Matha, Udupi, Karnataka, along with other dignitaries.
The Prime Minister unveiled the logo of the Birth Centenary Celebrations of Padma Vibhushan Yatikula Chakravarti Sri Vishwesha Tirtha Swamiji. He stated that his life of devotion, learning, and service continues to inspire countless people. Shri Modi added that the various initiatives being undertaken in the run-up to his birth centenary will further carry forward his noble ideals.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"Met Sri Sri Vishwaprasanna Tirtha Swamiji of Sri Pejavara Adhokshaja Matha, Udupi, along with other dignitaries.
Unveiled the logo of the Birth Centenary Celebrations of Padma Vibhushan Yatikula Chakravarti Sri Vishwesha Tirtha Swamiji. His life of devotion, learning and service continues to inspire countless people. The various initiatives being undertaken in the run-up to his birth centenary will further carry forward his noble ideals."
